reason: Main method is intraday reversal scalping on volume spikes and panic moves with quick holds (seconds to minutes), not approximable on daily bars.
style: discretionary intraday reversal with algo signals

universe.description: US stocks and ETFs that move quickly, including low-float names

setup.rule: Detect strong quick move down with increasing volume via custom algo
setup.quote: I'm looking for a a strong move down. And it's all I've kind of made algorithms that that kind of show me that move where a stock is moving down very quickly with a lot of volume.

setup.rule: Focus on panic reversals not news-driven
setup.quote: I'll try to stay away from news reversals, but I'll play more like the panic reversals

entry.rule: Wait for green bar after volume spike and add in
entry.quote: if the volume is increasing steadily and if the stock is falling at the same time, you know, pretty hard, that pretty much signals to me that it's coming to an to an end and then I'll look for a green bar and add in and then put a stop.

stop.quote: I'll risk maybe like 35 cents to make you know to at least make 55 or 60 cents

exits.quote: you try to make quick 25, 30, 40 cents and uh get out

sizing.rule: Scale to full size when criteria met, respect buying power
sizing.quote: if it's met uh I like to be in my in my full size

market_filter.quote: for me it's it's the VIX, you know, it's the volatility in the market. ... when the VIX is going crazy, when uh people are panicking, that's what that's what I like.

ambiguities.issue: Mentions shorting reversals and occasional long low-float momentum
ambiguities.assumption: Primary bread-and-butter is reversal scalping (long or short) but engine is long-only so not testable
